name: cryocooler-dashboard
description: Preact SPA dashboard for the ESP32 cryocooler controller

scripts.proto:build: pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/generated/telemetry.js ../proto/telemetry.proto && pbts -o src/generated/telemetry.d.ts src/generated/telemetry.js
scripts.build: npm run proto:build && tsc --noEmit && vite build
